    hotels=cached_hotels,
    restaurants=None,  # We will search for restaurants first
    groupBy="restaurant"
)

# cuisine: Chinese
# rating: 3.5 (which means [3.5, 5] as per the rule for single numeric rating)

restaurants = search_restaurants(
    city="Fresno",
    cuisine=["Chinese"],
    rating=[3.5, 5.0]
)

# Now use search_nearest to find restaurants near the hotels
nearest_restaurants = search_nearest(
    hotels=cached_hotels,
    restaurants=restaurants,
    groupBy="restaurant"
)

# Save the final result
save_to_cache(key="restaurants_near_hotels", value=nearest_restaurants)
